csv_row.author: mariourquia
csv_row.description: Assesses physical and transition climate risk for CRE properties and portfolios. Translates hazard exposure (flood, wind, wildfire, extreme heat, sea level rise) and regulatory/market shifts into financial impacts on NOI, cap rates, insurance costs, and tenant demand. Produces dollar-denominated risk, not abstract hazard scores.
csv_row.name: climate-risk-assessment
